title: Linked Lists

views.title: Linked Lists
views.intro: Use a dummy head whenever the head can change. Slow/fast pointers find the middle and the cycle; reversing the second half turns many problems (palindrome, reorder) into a merge of two lists. Draw the pointers before coding.
table: Middle, cycle entry, nth from end
Two lists, K lists by divide and conquer, sort list
Reorder, partition, rotate, copy with random pointer

files.desc: Reverse (range, k-group), swap pairs, middle, cycle, remove nth, merge, merge K, sort, reorder, palindrome, add numbers, intersection, dedupe II, partition, rotate, odd-even, copy random

pitfalls: Dummy head removes every "is it the head?" special case.
Save `next` BEFORE overwriting it when reversing.
Cycle entry: after slow meets fast, restart one pointer at the head and move both one step.

views.title: Linked Lists: Pointer Surgery
views.intro: More pointer surgery: prefix-sum tricks, in-place arithmetic on digit lists, conditional group reversal, circular and multilevel lists. Draw the pointers before coding.
table: Kth from the end, swap nodes
Reverse groups only if even length

files.desc: Remove zero-sum sublists, next larger node, split list in parts, plus one, swap nodes, delete middle, twin sum, merge between zeros, merge in between, reverse even-length groups, insertion sort list, binary to decimal, remove elements, insert into circular list, cycle length, flatten multilevel doubly linked list

pitfalls: Use a dummy head whenever the head can be removed or replaced.
Circular list insert: handle all-equal values and the wrap point (max then min).
After reversing a group, its old head becomes the tail: reconnect to the next group.
